entries.note: Translation audit round 1 of PR #3938 at d1a7d4066, 2026-11-14. Target es/browser.site_approval.json sha256 a485fd9be79157c8ad90fd910fcaca6b4966af5ec1215d6973f3b153521b0dcd (32/32 keys, new namespace). Semantic read of all 32 values against en, its context sidecar, glossary and the locale style guide; usage checked in browser_bridge/site_approval.py (Deny-first options, signer re-renders the card in every shipped locale), tui/app.py card title and the `lop browser sites` CLI. '<who, when>' verbatim per glossary §3), paths/URLs/flags, question line break and {origin}-before-{node}, NFC, no bidi controls, locale punctuation. Single independent audit on the same model family as the translator; no second/cross-model or native-speaker audit and no rendered RTL/overflow evidence claimed. entries.note: PR #4283 (fix/child-site-card-ancestor, head 4c2b7d00c) i18n audit round 1: independent reviewer session 7f5b5246af52 audited the 1 new key browser.site_approval.refused_outcome_unknown against en dc4eae99c932 and its .context.json note (toast when the node's browser may have applied the answer but its confirmation was lost; await_access and `lop browser sites` literal) and its two call sites in session.py _site_decide_bound (lost reply after dispatch, and every later tap on an 'unknown' card). Mechanical, whole namespace: key set and order equal en; vs base 1c29d7c22 only this key differs, every other value byte-identical (carried from the prior passed audit); no placeholders in en and none introduced; backtick span `lop browser sites` byte-identical; await_access kept as a literal; NFC; no bidi/control chars. Meaning preserved: outcome is unknown (may or may not have applied), do not answer the card again, the agent's await_access reads the browser itself, `lop browser sites` on the node shows what is stored; nothing claims approval or revocation. Glossary term for 'agent' checked. No corrections. Translator session not recorded in the PR (comment 'Narrowing — round 4' names coder, anthropic/claude-opus-5-5), so session left null. Native-speaker review and rendered-frame certification not claimed.
